prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “AI‑recommendation checker,” but the practical best option is a listings/knowledge‑graph service (Yext is the leader) combined with manual/automated checks against LLMs.

Why: modern LLMs (ChatGPT with browsing, Bing Chat, Bard, etc.) draw on knowledge graphs and major directories (Google Business Profile, Yelp, Apple Maps, Foursquare, data aggregators). A listings manager ensures your business info is correct where AIs get it; then you can test whether models recommend you.

Recommended approach

1) Fix your source data (highest leverage)
- Claim and optimize Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Yelp, Apple Maps, Facebook, TripAdvisor, industry directories.
- Publish schema.org LocalBusiness structured data on your website.
- Make sure NAP (name, address, phone) and hours, categories, and photos are correct.

2) Use a listings/knowledge service
- Yext — best if you want a single control point and to be visible to many publishers and some AI integrations. Good for enterprises and proactive AI visibility.
- BrightLocal, Moz Local, Whitespark, Synup — cheaper/smaller‑business focused alternatives that manage citations and local tracking.
- Make sure your data also flows to major data aggregators (Foursquare, Data Axle/Infogroup, Neustar/Localeze) — they feed many services.

3) Test whether LLMs recommend you
- Manual: ask ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Bard, Siri and Alexa prompts like “Recommend coffee shops near [address] that are [feature].” Try a few prompt variations (explicitly ask for top n and reasoning).
- Automated: use LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google PaLM) to run scripted queries for different user intents and locales; collect responses.
- Tools: no turnkey public service widely used just for “does ChatGPT recommend my business,” so most people run a small API script or use BrightLocal’s local rank tracking plus manual LLM checks.

4) Monitor reputation and mentions
- Use Birdeye, Podium, ReviewTrackers or Google Alerts to track reviews/mentions that influence AI answers.

Which to pick?
- If you want a single commercial solution to maximize the chance AIs will recommend you: start with Yext.
- If you’re budget‑conscious: BrightLocal or Moz Local + manual LLM checks (or a one‑off API script).
- If you just want to know now whether ChatGPT recommends you, tell me your business name + city and I can run some sample prompts (or give you exact prompts to run in ChatGPT/Bing).

Would you like me to run a few test prompts (if you give the business name and location), or recommend a budget plan for listings management?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
